given.note: Alex's crisis words after booking (K-34 v1 seed-outcome-crisis) are recorded already when the same text's record runs again: a lapsed turn's rerun, or the batch turn after the actor's arrival record (ids.ts; K-09 v1.1 j3-safety-arrival-batch-turn.json). Its first read finds the row under the barbershop's scope, so the record is a repeat and answers from the stored rows, writing nothing (record.ts default 1). The row comes back with its labels, tenses, the danger word's kind and its outcomes plain, as K-34 keeps them (K-34 default 5), and never its sealed words (K-34 README rule 6).
